scope: One development validation snapshot. Compare fixed model responses to deterministic Newton responses for signed action sequences. The current stage freezes and checks this plan offline.
initialization: Restore the same saved native snapshot independently for every branch. Replay the nominal branches and compare with both saved same-configuration references before any perturbation.
sequence_rule: Add sign * amplitude * direction to the frozen nominal actions. Segments use zero-based half-open control-lead indices, outside segments the offset is zero. Axis order is roll then pitch.

model.selection: Use the existing comparison baseline. Later expanded or surface candidates did not clear the replacement gates.

gates.nominal: Require identical control, timing and retention classification versus both saved replays. Use archive-import numerical ceilings and require H8/H16/H32 position half spread <= 1 um over all combinations of new and saved native branches.
gates.causality: Check exact common first eight control commands for pulse and reversal at each sign. In physics compare their shared first-eight-step trajectories within the nominal numerical and position-resolution ceilings. The model rolls its own prior predictions and uses only causal analytic tool inputs.
gates.comparison: For each direction, lead and vector family use the larger of the SI floor, 5x each lead's same-session nominal half spread and a float roundoff floor. A Newton half-distance below the floor is unresolved; at least 10x is strong. At H32 report whether both model JVP and finite secant meet cosine >= 0.8 and relative vector error <= 0.5 against a strong Newton position secant. Report eligibility losses, norm ratios, even shifts, and nominal prediction error. H8/H16, velocity and spin are diagnostics. A single finite amplitude establishes no near-zero Newton derivative or control acceptance.

stop_conditions: Frozen hashes, snapshot layout/readback or runtime mismatch
Static controller, action derivative, or nominal replay gate fails
Invalid, constrained or incomplete transition, or shared action prefix check fails
Resource cap or eight complete branches; no automatic amplitude, seed, or snapshot changes
